column1: # Ground truth for the easing catalogue, generated from meo-canvas v1's built module
# (`dist/esm/animate`) rather than from either v2 implementation.
# v1 at tag v9.0.2, commit 890eed2, working tree clean. The tag is here so
# this file can be regenerated comparably: a vector table whose provenance
# is "v1" cannot be, and one that names a commit can. The build was newer
# than its source when this ran, so it is not a stale artifact -- which is
# a thing that happened to us on this tree the same afternoon.
# Neither surface may be written from the other: a misreading of v1 that
# reaches both looks like agreement. Both are written against this, and this
# came from v1 running, not from anyone reading it.
# What a table catches that nothing else does: `expo(0)` computed rather
# than special-cased gives 0.000977, which is not a bug anyone finds by
# looking -- it is a curve that starts almost at rest, and at eight pixels
# of travel it is a hundredth of a pixel. No fixture, no eye and no
# tolerance catches that. An exact zero in a row does.
# Values are printed at JavaScript default precision, which is the shortest
# string that round-trips an f64 exactly -- so both surfaces parse the same
# number rather than a rounded one.
